title: Posted Schedule of Handling Shrink on Conditioned Loads, Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
Grain that comes in wet or damp is handled twice, and the handling shrink posted below is taken on the loads standing against a contract under Grain Marketing Contracts. Handling shrink on conditioned loads is taken on the net bushels of every load standing against the contract, whatever the facility and whatever the disposition. The rate turns on the condition the loads were probed at.

| Condition of the loads standing against the contract | Handling shrink taken on conditioned loads |
|---|---|
| Two or more loads were probed wet and at least one further load was probed damp | 0.85 percent |
| One load was probed wet, or two or more loads were probed damp, but that pair of conditions is not met | 0.45 percent |
| Neither of those holds | none |

## Reading the two bands apart

The heavy band asks for two conditions at once: at least two wet loads, and at least one damp load beyond them. Two wet loads and no damp load does not reach it; two wet loads and one damp load does. The light band is reached either by a single wet load or by two damp loads, so a contract carrying one wet load and nothing else takes 0.45 percent, and a contract carrying two damp loads and no wet load takes the same 0.45 percent. A contract whose loads were all probed at or under the moisture base takes none.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical loads

| Wet loads | Damp loads | Rate taken |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | 0.85 percent |
| 2 | 0 | 0.45 percent |
| 1 | 0 | 0.45 percent |
| 0 | 2 | 0.45 percent |
| 0 | 1 | none |
| 0 | 0 | none |

## Illustration on hypothetical bushels

Where the loads standing against a contract carry 16,000.00 net bushels between them, counting every one of them whatever the facility and whatever the disposition, three of them probed wet and one damp, the shrink is 0.85 percent of those bushels, being 136.00 bushels. On the same loads with one probed wet and none damp, it is 0.45 percent, being 72.00 bushels.
